title: AMF aborts before sending NRF subscriptions (v2.7.5)

labels.name: Housekeeping:ToClose
labels.description: Issues reviewed and closed. Old requests, issues which are not bug, feature or documentation request

body:
## Key observation
Based on NRF logs, AMF seems to crash before NRF receives the POST /nnrf-nfm/v1/subscriptions requests. AMF logs show two subscription requests “SENDING…”, but NRF does not log “Subscription created” at the corresponding timestamp.

## Environment
- Open5GS: v2.7.5
- Deployment: docker-compose
- Network: docker bridge 172.22.0.0/16
- AMF: 172.22.0.10:7777
- NRF: 172.22.0.12:7777
- SCP: 172.22.0.35:7777

## Expected behavior
AMF should not abort on subscription creation failure; it should log an error and retry.

## Questions

1. Under what conditions can ogs_sbi_subscription_data_add() be called with NULL subscription_data?
2. Why is NRF de-registering AMF for “No heartbeat” even though AMF sends PATCH very close in time? Is there a known timing/race in docker-compose environments?
3. Is this crash known in v2.7.5 and fixed by a later release/commit?
